---- MODULE Case ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
(* --algorithm A variables x=0; macro Test(a) begin assert a; end macro;
begin L:Test(/\ x=0
             /\ x<2); B:skip; end algorithm *)
====
generated_body:
VARIABLES pc, x

vars == << pc, x >>

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ x = 0
        /\ pc = "L"

L == /\ pc = "L"
     /\ Assert(/\ x=0
               /\ x<2, 
               "Failure of assertion at line 3, column 53 of macro called at line 4, column 9.")
     /\ pc' = "B"
     /\ x' = x

B == /\ pc = "B"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "Done"
     /\ x' = x

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == L \/ B
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
